status: draft, not yet verified against test bakes
note: Dough temperature (°C) at the end of mixing to hours of bulk fermentation, counted from the moment the salt goes in, and the rise (%) to look for. For a ripe, active starter: 450 g strong white flour, 150 g starter, 300 g water, 10 g salt (70% hydration). The planner uses maxHours, the longer end of each range.
tooCool: Below 16°C the dough is too cool to rely on a clock: go by the cues.
tooWarm: Above 32°C the dough is too warm: cool it first and watch it closely.
